subject: Request: publish customer story + 15-minute video clip (post-POC results)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@pritech.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@pritech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: publish customer story + 15-minute video clip (post-POC results)

Hi Emily / Tom,

First — huge thanks again for partnering on the two-week POC. The team here and at PriTech moved quickly and the results are really promising. Below is a short summary of the outcomes we would like to include in a customer story and a short 15-minute recorded clip: 

Key highlights from the POC:
- 40% reduction in average inference latency at 8k context (from 360ms -> 215ms)
- 3.2x throughput improvement on peak batch workloads with our batching/caching config
- Estimated token cost savings ~28% after KV caching and quantization profile adjustments
- Maintained NPS-like internal quality score (redwood eval set) with a 1.4% change in hallucination rate

Attachments: pilot_summary.pdf (PDF, 2 pages) and latency_chart.png (PNG) — quick graphs you can review.

Ask: with your permission we’d like to do two things:
1) Publish a one-page customer story on redwood.com that quotes a short 1–2 sentence blurb from PriTech about the impact above (we’ll share the exact wording before publishing).
2) Record a 15-minute video clip (remote, unlisted) where someone from your team (product/ops/engineering) can speak to the outcomes and the integration experience. We’ll handle recording and quick editing — we just need sign-off on the clip and text.

Suggested next steps:
- If this sounds fine, we can send a short permission form and a proposed quote blurb for legal review.
- Proposed windows for a 15-min recording next week: Tue 12/7 10:00-11:30 PT or Wed 12/8 14:00-16:00 PT.

If you prefer someone else on your side do the on-camera piece, tell me who and we’ll coordinate. Happy to tighten the quote text to fewer words.

Thanks,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0173
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- pilot_summary.pdf (application/pdf)
- latency_chart.png (image/png)
From: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@pritech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@pritech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: publish customer story + 15-minute video clip (post-POC results)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and congrats to both teams. We’re pleased with the numbers; the latency and cost wins are material for our use case. 

A couple quick notes before we proceed:
- We will need our legal team to sign off on the final quote wording and the release form. Can you send the proposed quote text and the standard release we use for video clips?
- On the quote blurb, could we avoid the word \"cost savings\" and instead use \"unit cost reduction\" (legal prefers that phrasing).

Regarding the recording: Tom can do the on-camera piece. Tue 12/7 at 10:30 PT would work for us — please confirm and send the calendar invite (30 minutes reserved).

Thanks — Emily

Marissa / Ben — quick update from our side: legal reviewed the release and approved the file with one tiny edit (they prefer the phrase \"unit cost reduction\" instead of \"cost savings\" in the quote).

We’re happy to be featured. Tom will take the 12/7 10:30 PT slot — please send the calendar invite and the final quote text for sign-off. For the quote, please make the concise version read: 

\"By switching to Redwood’s inference runtime, PriTech reduced inference latency by ~40% and realized a meaningful unit cost reduction for high-throughput workloads\"

If you could send the invite and the recording checklist (mic, screen share examples), we’ll be ready.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Saunders
Head of ML Engineering | PriTech
emily.saunders@pritech.com
